---
title: "Install"
---

Prosodic runs on **Python 3.10+**. The only system dependency is
[espeak](https://github.com/espeak-ng/espeak-ng), a free text-to-speech
engine used to phonemize words that are not in the CMU pronunciation
dictionary.

## 1. Install espeak

- **Mac** (with [Homebrew](https://brew.sh)):

    ```sh
    brew install espeak
    ```

- **Linux**:

    ```sh
    apt-get install espeak libespeak1 libespeak-dev
    ```

- **Windows**: download and install from the
  [espeak-ng releases](https://github.com/espeak-ng/espeak-ng/releases/latest).

## 2. Install prosodic

From PyPI:

```sh
pip install prosodic
```

Or the development version straight from GitHub:

```sh
pip install git+https://github.com/quadrismegistus/prosodic
```

### Optional extras

- **Phrasal stress** (`syntax=True`) needs spaCy and a small English model:

    ```sh
    pip install "prosodic[syntax]"
    python -m spacy download en_core_web_sm
    ```

    See [Phrasal stress](methods/phrasal-stress.qmd) for what this enables.

- **GPU acceleration** is automatic when a working PyTorch install with CUDA
  or Apple MPS is present; otherwise the parser runs on CPU (numpy). No GPU
  is required.

## 3. Check it works

```python
import prosodic
prosodic.Text("Shall I compare thee to a summer's day?").parse()
```

Or launch the web app (see [Web app](webapp.qmd)):

```sh
prosodic web
```

If you would rather not install anything locally, use the hosted app at
[prosodic.app](https://prosodic.app) or the remote client (covered on the
[home page](index.qmd)).
